transcript.text: What temperature should chicken be cooked to?

expectedOutput.criteria: States 165°F (74°C) for chicken, cited from the food-safety article, and says to check with an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part.

metadata.comment: Didn't say how to check: use an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part.
metadata.flaggedAnswer: For all poultry, including ground poultry, the safe internal cooking temperature is 165°F (74°C) [1].
